summary: Authored an 8-phase implementation plan from the research report. It relocates the 9-suite slow cost-class bucket onto its own serialized gate so Gate 8 fits under the 600s foreground ceiling with no coverage reduction, replaces the advisory batch-gate-deferral directive with a staleness-bounded marker plus entry guards in verify-deploy.sh and run-all.sh (covering a batch of one, which the current -gt 1 gate excludes), generalizes Gate 8's contention tagging to every gate's timeout kill, and wires the already-existing dispatch-strand-probe.sh into a watchdog launched beside the dispatches. Research question 5's blocking open item is closed by building on background Bash rather than an unverified background-Agent capability.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan covering the gate-8 ceiling fit, the mechanical batch-gate guard, generalized contention tagging, and orchestrator-side stall detection.

next_action_hint: Run /orchestrate 610 --implement to execute the plan. Phase 1's measurement needs a confirmed-idle host; it carries a documented deferred branch if one is not available.
